Welcome to Upper Prep & Senior School
The start of the GCSE pathway begins in Upper Prep where we provide a supportive, friendly and well-disciplined environment where every child is truly known where pupils can fully achieve their academic potential and flourish as confident, rounded individuals.
Welcome to Upper Prep and Senior School
Durlston provides a supportive but challenging learning environment, consolidating skills, knowledge and attitude as our pupils begin their journey to GCSE and beyond. Parents and pupils alike will receive a warm welcome into the Durlston Family.
You will find that the size of our school means that every pupil is known, which enables our dedicated and talented teachers to engage and motivate every single pupil.
We are blessed with fantastic facilities but we are proud of our outstanding teachers that will help your child to reach their potential. Personalised learning plans and performance monitoring help staff and pupils to analyse progress.
It is the relationship between staff and pupils that makes a Durlston education so unique.
Darren Collard, Head of Senior School
“Durlston is filled with teachers that care deeply, not only for the subjects they teach but also for the development of individual children.“ Durlston parent
“Our teachers are patient, understanding and genuinely want to see you succeed” Year 11 Pupil

Pre-Prep Curriculum
Our rich and varied curriculum is enhanced by exciting experiences, trips and special events; there are so many happy memories to be made. We also make time for the children to simply enjoy being children, with simple pleasures such as turning a cardboard box into a space rocket, jumping in puddles and playing with the leaves on a windy day!
In Reception, traditions such as baking cakes on your fifth birthday are enjoyed alongside a whole host of other exciting introductions to school life. Learning takes place through a combination of child-led and teacher-initiated activities, both inside the classroom and outside and in our woodland classroom.
Throughout Years 1 and 2, the teachers deliver an inspiring Creative Curriculum which enables the children to become experts in our carefully chosen topics, including Festivals and Celebrations, Wonderful Woods, Frozen Planet and Fairytale Castles. The National Curriculum objectives are fully delivered through these topics, which also feature highlights such as beach trips, a pirate adventure day, an alien disco and even a mediaeval banquet!
Every child in Pre-Prep enjoys an individual daily reading session with a trained adult. This one to one attention, alongside a daily phonics lesson, ensures that your child can make the very best progress in this key area. The children certainly love the opportunity to have a cosy chat each morning!
Outdoor adventures are plentiful as we have so many beautiful places to enjoy in the school grounds. Awe and wonder can be seen as the children observe the seasons, plants, birds and other wildlife on nature walks, whilst pond dipping and when walking the Magnificent Mile. Regular visits to our woodland classroom and Physical Education lessons, including Dance, ensure even the very youngest Durlston children have opportunities to develop perseverance, resilience and confidence, with careful guidance from our specialist staff.
Learning is vibrant, interactive and fun. Whether playing French vocabulary games, learning a new song in the Music School, or competing in a Lego construction challenge, laughter is never far away!

Welcome to Pre-Prep
The journey starts here! Our bright, airy classrooms are filled with happiness, laughter and enthusiasm for learning. Passionate and caring staff ensure that everyone has the chance to shine.
Durlston Pre-Prep is a truly magical place to be. From tiny two year olds to inquisitive seven year olds, all our children are carefully nurtured through the start of their educational journey. Their days are filled with rich learning experiences and plenty of smiles!
The partnership between home and school is at the heart of everything we do and we love nothing more than a chat at the classroom door each day. Our aim is for parents to feel as much a part of school life as the children do. We find that this mutually supportive approach really helps our youngest Durlstonians to thrive.
We pride ourselves on exceptional pastoral care and with very generous adult to child ratios, we know and love every child as a unique individual. This helps us to put wellbeing first, whilst tailoring the learning experience to ensure that everyone achieves their full potential.
Gilly Smith, Head of Pre-Prep

Kindergarten Experience
A safe, happy and nurturing environment for children aged two to four years old.
Kindergarten
The youngest members of the Durlston family begin their journey in Kindergarten. Excellent ratios and experienced staff mean that we are able to care for each child as the unique individual that they are. Each will settle, learn and grow in different ways and we wholeheartedly embrace this.
We offer total flexibility in terms of the school day. A half hour drop-off slot allows us time and space to welcome each child personally and to chat with parents. You may then choose whatever session length works best for you as a family.
The standard day ends at 3.15pm
Kindergarten Experience
Kindergarten is a happy and purposeful nursery environment where the children flow freely between indoors and outdoors. A huge range of activities are available, all carefully designed to stimulate learning and promote communication. The younger children learn from their older role-models and the older ones simply adore looking after their smaller friends. Each day, we focus on social turn-taking tasks, language development and physical challenges, as well as early phonics, numeracy and literacy for the older members of the group. We motivate and inspire the children by planning multi-sensory activities based around their own personal interests.
We recognise that leaving your child for the first time is a huge step and we are passionate about supporting you as a family to ensure that starting Kindergarten is an exciting and enjoyable pre-school experience for all.

Aims and Values
Welcome to Durlston School. A place where children are inspired to learn, grow and belong.
Developing Confidence and Individual Talents
At Durlston, every child is known, valued and encouraged to reach their full potential. We provide a nurturing environment where academic ambition is balanced with outstanding pastoral care, giving children the confidence to thrive both in and beyond the classroom.
Our broad and engaging curriculum challenges pupils to think creatively, develop resilience and discover their individual strengths. Alongside academic excellence, children enjoy a wealth of opportunities in sport, music, drama, outdoor learning and the arts, helping them build confidence, character and a lifelong love of learning.
Learning at Durlston is purposeful, inspiring and hands-on. Whether exploring new ideas in the classroom, performing on stage, competing on the sports field or taking part in outdoor adventures, every experience is designed to spark curiosity and encourage personal growth.
Our dedicated staff create a supportive community where children feel safe to ask questions, embrace challenges and celebrate success. Guided by our core values of respect, kindness, responsibility and confidence, pupils develop into thoughtful, compassionate and capable young people who are ready for the future.
We invite you to discover Durlston School. A place where every child is supported, inspired and empowered to make the most of every opportunity.
Our Aims
Individual - We remain committed to an innovative and forward-thinking approach to education, shaping each child’s learning journey so it reflects their unique strengths, needs and aspirations.
Childhood - We encourage children to grow into confident, courteous and considerate members of the community, embracing each day with enthusiasm and contributing positively to school life.
Opportunities - Through a rich and thoughtfully designed curriculum, we help pupils become adaptable, resilient and reflective learners, equipped with essential skills for life.
Uniqueness - We provide an environment where pupils feel safe to be themselves, take risks, think independently and tackle challenges, fostering personal growth, emerging leadership and genuine fulfilment.
Community - We build lasting, supportive relationships among pupils, parents, staff and alumni, creating a strong school community that stands the test of time - The Durlston Family.

School History and Alumni
Founded in 1903 by the visionary educator Mr G.T. Atkinson, Durlston was created with a clear purpose: to inspire young minds through a nurturing education built on character, curiosity and ambition. What began as a small preparatory school overlooking the Dorset coastline has grown into a thriving and forward-thinking community, while remaining true to the values on which it was founded. Today, Durlston continues to honour its rich heritage while embracing the opportunities of the future, preparing children not only for academic success, but for confident, compassionate and purposeful lives in a changing world.
We are extremely proud of the history of Durlston School and it is important for future generations that “Old Durlstonians” have a place to share memories and have the opportunity to keep up to date with events at Durlston.
Below you will find a collection of memories from Old Durlstonians. Enjoy the memories!

History
2015 - Mr Richard May became Headmaster. Facilities at Durlston were further extended to include a Design Technology Centre equipped with 3D printers, laser cutter and laptops, a Ceramics Studio and Outdoor Art Terrace and multi-purpose hard courts for tennis, hockey, football and netball.
​​​​​2023 - 'Durlston Prep and Senior School' welcomed the first Year 9 pupils as the school extends to 16, allowing pupils current and new, to continue their education to Year 11 and GCSE examinations.
Present Day - Durlston continues to grow and expand facilities, moving forward with ongoing requirements of a modern school without losing the strong tradition of the school's history.

If you attended Durlston School we would love to hear from you and to keep in touch.

Durlston Fees
At Durlston, we are committed to delivering an exceptional independent education in a nurturing, ambitious environment for children aged 2 to 16. Our fees reflect the outstanding quality of teaching, pastoral care, and the breadth of opportunities available to every pupil throughout their school journey.
From Nursery to Senior School, pupils benefit from small class sizes, specialist teaching, excellent facilities, and a rich programme of academic, sporting, creative, and co-curricular experiences. Every aspect of school life is designed to inspire curiosity, build confidence, and help each child realise their full potential.
What Your Fees Include
Our fee structure is reviewed annually and presented with clarity and transparency, helping families make informed decisions about a Durlston education.
School fees cover a wide range of opportunities and experiences, including:
• Outstanding teaching and academic provision • Exceptional pastoral care and wellbeing support • Specialist teaching across a broad curriculum • Access to excellent learning resources and facilities • A diverse co-curricular programme • Games and sporting activities • Many educational visits and enrichment experiences
Some activities, residential trips, public examinations, individual music tuition, and extended care are charged separately. Full details can be found in the school's Terms and Conditions and Fee Schedule.
Payment of Fees
Fees are payable termly in advance and can be paid using a range of convenient payment methods. Flexible payment options may also be available through approved providers.
For further information on payment schedules, deposits, notice periods, or terms of entry, please contact the Bursar, who will be happy to assist.

Assistance with Fees
We offer a means tested bursary scheme. This is an offer of financial assistance to those who would otherwise be unable to afford our fees.

How to Apply?
Applicants will be asked to complete a detailed financial questionnaire in order for the appropriate level of assistance to be determined. Our Bursar will be on hand to help prospective parents with the completion of this form if necessary and the details are then assessed by our Finance and General Purposes committee prior to any terms being offered. All applications are dealt with sensitively and in the strictest confidence and in accordance with GDPR regulations. You are not committed in any way by this process and if no terms are available or the terms offered are not acceptable, any applications are securely destroyed and no records are maintained.
Are you thinking that you may not qualify?
It goes without saying that if you do not apply then you will never know whether a Durlston education would have been possible for your child or children. Not all applicants are successful, but assistance terms can be generous to those who are, though this will not amount to free education.
If you would like further information or to arrange an appointment with our Bursar please complete our enquiry form and we will be in touch with you.
Scholarships
Durlston’s fundamental purpose is to provide an exceptional education for every child, giving them the skills to engage and thrive in the world of today and in the future. We have a long-standing reputation for educational excellence; the children here embrace challenge and opportunity, and staff seize every opportunity to make learning and life at school an enriched adventure. Although there is a financial discount associated with a scholarship, the key aspect of the award is the extra support, opportunity and extension available. Our specialist teaching staff share their academic and co-curricular passions, nurturing individual talent and potential.
Application and examination will take place in autumn and spring term for the following September. We offer Academic, Drama, Music, Sport and Visual Arts Scholarships. See below for details.
It is possible to achieve a scholarship in more than one area. Scholarships can be applied for in conjunction with a bursary application as part of our Community Scholarship Bursary.

Head's Welcome
Welcome to Durlston! As Headmaster, I am incredibly proud to be part of such a happy and successful independent school. A school where children are excited about coming to learn, arriving each day to a positive, nurturing atmosphere with so many chances for them to shine. We have wonderful facilities and grounds but it is our dedicated staff team that makes the biggest difference. An inspiring group who ensure that all of the children make exceptional progress in their learning and that they have a huge amount of fun doing so.
Durlston is a place where everyone is known, where confidence can be nurtured and individuals can grow at their own pace. Within such a supportive environment – anything is possible!
At Durlston, we believe every child deserves an education that inspires confidence, nurtures curiosity, and opens doors to opportunity. From the age of two through to GCSEs, we provide an exceptional education within a caring and ambitious community where every pupil is known, valued, and encouraged to achieve their very best.
Our aim is simple. We want every child to leave Durlston not only with excellent academic outcomes, but with the confidence, character, and resilience to thrive in an ever-changing world. Academic excellence sits alongside outstanding pastoral care, ensuring pupils feel supported, challenged, and inspired throughout every stage of their journey.
One of Durlston's greatest strengths is our ability to see each child as an individual. Small class sizes, specialist teaching, and a broad, enriching curriculum enable pupils to develop their talents and discover new passions. Whether in the classroom, on the sports field, on the stage, in the art studio, or through leadership opportunities, every child is encouraged to embrace challenge, think independently, and strive for excellence.
Our community is built on kindness, respect, integrity, and a genuine love of learning. These values shape daily life at Durlston and create an environment where children feel happy, secure, and confident to be themselves. Strong relationships between pupils, staff, and families foster a real sense of belonging and ensure that every child is supported to flourish.
Choosing the right school is one of the most important decisions a family will make. We are proud of what makes Durlston distinctive and would be delighted to welcome you to experience our school for yourself. I hope you enjoy exploring our website and look forward to meeting you and your family in the future.
Our size is our strength!
Small school, big ambitions and high achievements! Durlston School is known for its family feel: children, staff, parents, grandparents and alumni are all proud to be part of this very special bond- ‘The Durlston Family’. A place where everyone is known, where confidence can be nurtured and individuals can grow at their own pace and within such a supportive environment – anything is possible!
